existing_issues.issue: Catalogue 'Air' is Puts's Aria AKA 'Air' (violin & piano, 2000, 4 min); Puts's own 'Air' (2004) is a cello movement of Four Airs
Composer's site lists duration as 15 (likely an error for a short encore); catalogue 4 min kept
Publisher title is 'Fantasie No. 1 in G minor' (5 min), catalogue spells 'Fantasy' and has 8 min
Publisher title is 'Fantasy No. 2 in F-sharp minor' (5.5 min), catalogue spells 'Fantasie' and has 8 min
Movement timings on the composer's site total about 43 minutes (publisher lists 40); catalogue 45
Recorded timings total about 24 minutes (catalogue 18); five movements
Title in catalogue includes the year; recorded duration 21 minutes
